name: ⚔️ [NEW MAP] Zulu Wars
desc:
Zulu Wars 📯 is a historical PvE game set during the Victorian Zulu War. Fight as a British defender or join the Zulu forces in intense wave-based battles inspired by real engagements such as Rorke's Drift. Choose from an arsenal of historical weapons including lever-action rifles, breech-loaders, revolvers, artillery, swords & more!

👉 Survive waves, earn coins, unlock new weapons and progress through regiments as you fight for victory.

🌿 PREMIUM BENEFITS: 2x coins

'HENRY WEST' UPDATE 17/04/27:
- Added Rorke's Drift Remastered map /w accessible roof
- Henry West custom voicelines for Colonel+
- Reworked pathfinding
- Zulu sharpshooters on later waves

📌 Take note
This game simply wishes to portray historical battles, and does not support racism of any kind. People in-game who engage in racism will be banned. Please be respectful!

📋 Tags
Rorke's Drift, Isandlwana, Victorian, Line Battle, Bot Defence, Military
